question: Under IRS rules, how many IRA-to-IRA 60-day rollovers can a person make within a 12-month period across all of their IRAs?
true_option: Only one rollover per 12 months across all IRAs combined
false_option: One rollover per year for each separate IRA
true_claim_text: only one 60-day rollover is allowed per 12 months across all IRAs
false_claim_text: each separate IRA gets its own annual rollover
source: IRS (Announcement 2014-32, following Bobrow v. Commissioner): the one-rollover-per-year limit applies in aggregate to all of a taxpayer's IRAs, not per account.
